name: pistack
description: The Pi edition of Cursor's pstack: router mode, playbooks, principles and routed skills, generated from the vendored upstream and translated for Pi in a terminal and under T3 Code.

scripts.sync: git -C ../.. submodule update --init packages/pistack/vendor/pstack && node generator/generate.mjs
scripts.check: node generator/generate.mjs --check && node generator/lint-skills.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:once && T3_MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp npm run test:once
scripts.test:once: node --test test/*.test.mjs test/*.test.ts && cd skills/poteto-mode/scripts && node --test check-plan.test.ts watch-pr/*.test.ts orch/*.test.ts
